sentences.en: The only useful answers are those that raise new questions.
sentences.zh: 只有那些能引发新问题的回答才是有用的。

sentences.en: Work hard, and your salary will be raised by degrees.
sentences.zh: 努力工作，你的工资将逐步提高。

sentences.en: And you are going to raise it in three days?
sentences.zh: 你打算三天内就把它筹集起来吗？

senses.zh: 提高；筹集；养育；升起；饲养，种植
